title: Every bus, train and ferry in San Diego in 24 hours
description:
Every bus, train and ferry running in San Diego on an average October weekday, from the morning rush to the next morning, in 50 seconds.

I took the October 2026 timetables, kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays, and put each vehicle where its schedule says it is. The count is the average for that minute and only includes vehicles inside the San Diego city limits. The faded ones are just outside. Colours: Bus, Rapid, Trolley and Ferry.

Busiest moment: 281 vehicles at 3:43 pm.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out Columbus Day (October 12).
